claim: Choluteca bridge withstood a hurricane in 1998 but the river changed course and no longer flows under the bridge.
evidence: In 1998, Honduras was hit by Hurricane Mitch, a category 5 storm that devastated the Caribbean. The Choluteca Bridge stood its ground against Hurricane Mitch and survived in near perfect condition. Even though the bridge stood its ground, there was one problem, the storm caused the river to carve a completely new path which no longer ran under the bridge.
